pattern: whenever ~ attacks for the first time each turn

examples.text: Whenever ~ attacks for the first time each turn, draw a card.
Whenever ~ attacks for the first time each turn, untap all lands you control.

counterExamples: Whenever ~ attacks for the first time each combat, draw a card.
Whenever ~ attacks for the second time each turn, draw a card.
Whenever ~ blocks for the first time each turn, draw a card.

pattern: ( after this phase , there is an additional combat phase | there is an additional combat phase after this phase )

examples.text: Whenever ~ attacks for the first time each turn, untap all lands you control. After this phase, there is an additional combat phase.
Untap all creatures you control. After this phase, there is an additional combat phase.
Untap all creatures you control and there is an additional combat phase after this phase.

counterExamples: Untap all creatures you control. After this phase, there is an additional main phase.
Untap all creatures you control. After this turn, there is an additional combat phase.
Untap all creatures you control. After this phase, there are two additional combat phases.

pattern: prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to {o:Obj} {d:Dur}

examples.text: Untap target creature. Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to it this turn.
Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to target creature you control this turn.

counterExamples: Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt by target creature you control this turn.
Prevent all noncombat damage that would be dealt to target creature you control this turn.
Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to target creature you control.

pattern: if ( a | an ) {f:Filter} would be put into a graveyard from anywhere , exile it instead

examples.text: If an artifact or enchantment card would be put into a graveyard from anywhere, exile it instead.
If a creature card would be put into a graveyard from anywhere, exile it instead.

counterExamples: If an artifact or enchantment card would be put into your graveyard from anywhere, exile it instead.
If an artifact or enchantment card would be put into a graveyard from the battlefield, exile it instead.
If an artifact or enchantment card would be put into a graveyard from anywhere, shuffle it into its owner's library instead.

pattern: whenever a source you control deals noncombat damage to an opponent

examples.text: Whenever a source you control deals noncombat damage to an opponent, you gain that much life.
Whenever a source you control deals noncombat damage to an opponent, scry 1.

counterExamples: Whenever a source you control deals combat damage to an opponent, scry 1.
Whenever a source an opponent controls deals noncombat damage to you, scry 1.
Whenever a source you control deals noncombat damage to a creature, scry 1.

pattern: you can spend mana of any type to cast {f:Filter}

examples.text: You can spend mana of any type to cast artifact spells.
You can spend mana of any type to cast Dragon spells.

counterExamples: You can spend mana of any color to cast artifact spells.
You can spend mana of any type to activate abilities of artifacts you control.
Your opponents can spend mana of any type to cast artifact spells.
